# dsh-nextsteps
English · Português (Brasil) · 简体中文
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-nextsteps) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepse
www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-nextsteps) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
**Every finished agent turn ends with ready-to-click next steps.**
`dsh-nextsteps` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that prompts the model to suggest about three followup
prompts at the end of every turn, renders them as clickable cards under the completed turn, and send
s the clicked prompt as your next message — one click, zero typing.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Product tour
1. Ask anything. The model works, answers, and calls the native `suggest_followups` tool right befor

e its final answer.
2. The completed turn renders its own suggestion cards — attributed to that turn

, never repeated across messages.
3. Click a card: the prompt is sent verbatim as your next queued m

essage and the card flips to a sent state.
4. Everything survives restarts: cards, their turn attrib

ution, and which ones you already clicked.
5. Open the dsh settings → **Nextsteps** to pick the gene
ration language (15 languages or Auto), how many suggestions you get per turn (1–6), and whether the
small header shows.
## Features
- Per-turn attribution — suggestions stay attached to the turn that produced them, across reloads an

d app restarts.
- One-click send through the session's own conversation controller, with a composer

fallback.
- Persistent captures: clicked cards stay marked after restarts (content-addressed keys, t

urn backfilled from history).
- Model-supplied labels, with automatic truncation when absent; strict

payload validation with corrective model feedback.
- Settings page inside the dsh settings — langua

ge, followups per turn, header visibility, updates.
- Followups generated in the selected language —

15 languages or Auto, which follows the conversation.
- In-app updater — version check, one-click i

nstall, release notes, restart prompt.
- UI in English, Português (Brasil) and 简体中文.
## Settings
Open the dsh settings and find the **Nextsteps** section:
| Setting | What it does |

| Language | The language the model writes followups in. `Auto` follows the conversation. |
| Follow

ups per turn | How many suggested prompts the model produces (1–6). |
| Show header | The small labe
l above the cards. |
## Updates
The same settings page checks GitHub for new releases. When a newer version is published on npm, **U
pdate now** installs it through the dsh plugin manager and asks you to restart. Updates only ever in
stall the `dsh-nextsteps` npm package — a renamed or development copy is detected and left alone.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (desktop, web profile).
- Node.js 20+.
